title: The Teeth
question: Which type of tooth is it?
lines: You use these front teeth to bite into an apple. Name them.
Watch the glowing teeth at the very front of the upper jaw.
Which type of tooth is glowing?
Canines are the pointed teeth right beside them.
These flat, chisel-shaped teeth are made for cutting.
Why it matters: adults have eight, four on top and four below.

title: The Teeth
question: How many of these do adults have?
lines: Between your pointed and grinding teeth sit the premolars.
Watch the glowing teeth between the canines and the big molars.
How many of these teeth does an adult have?
Adults have 12 molars, counting wisdom teeth, but those are different.
Two in each quarter of the mouth makes eight.
Why it matters: premolars replace the baby molars.
